name: Missing Secret Reference
root_cause: The deployment references a Secret named 'db-credentials' via secretKeyRef that does not exist in the namespace.
fix_steps: Create the missing Secret with 'kubectl create secret generic db-credentials --from-literal=password=changeme -n oncall-bench' or remove the env var reference.
confirm_commands: kubectl get pod -l app=secret -n oncall-bench -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}'
